arStrings.szText: {c_label}Active: {/c}Enemies that die while afflicted with the active Poisoning damage have a {c_number}[SF_34*100|%|]{/c} chance to trigger another active effect for free.

{c_label}Active: {/c}{c_important}Poison Creeper's{/c} active effect becomes an aura around you for {c_number}{buffduration:UPGRADEC_MAIN}{/c} seconds, dealing {c_number}{dot:UPGRADEC_TOOLTIP_POISON}{/c} total Poisoning damage and Slowing enemies by {c_number}[SF_35*100|%|]{/c}. {c_important}Poison Creeper{/c} no longer Immobilizes.
{c_label}Active: {/c}{c_important}Poison Creeper's{/c} active Poisoning duration is increased by {c_number}{SF_14}{/c} seconds.
